name: Cabbage Ginger Soup
steps: Heat the oil and cook ginger and garlic for 1 minute.
Add cabbage and carrot and stir for 3 minutes.
Pour in the stock and soy sauce and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the crumbled tofu and cook for 3 minutes.
Season with pepper and finish with spring onion.
note: Low in calories and high in volume; the tofu keeps it filling.
